scope: Research findings only. Code and generated dashboard remain in the local research checkout; not integrated into production.

round2.aggression_assumption: Exploratory synthetic supplier exits on the first package worth less than 78% of its opening. This threshold is invented, not inferred from real suppliers. Separate from the original evaluation.

adaptive.protocol: Post-hoc exploratory comparison. Fresh seeds 401/503; previously evaluated suppliers. No retuning or online sessions.

limits: Synthetic savings are not official scores.
Only one hosted demo run per setup.
Adaptive extension reuses supplier identities and has not run online.
Adaptive and fixed-20 adaptive-concession policies produced identical per-case results.
No LLM training or completed model-backed A/B/C comparison.
